I.value_en: fcop/fcop-mcp 1.6.0, release process, checklists, working tree, P=E four files, snapshot, version files, GitHub Actions, and PyPI.

I.notes_en: Adjudication accesses no network, Actions, PyPI, or Git.

O.value_en: P=E fix, check report, local build/smoke, tag, push, Actions release, PyPI verification, REPORT-009, and archive.

A.value_zh: 执行 13 步检查、build、报告、P=E、双发布与真实安装验证；任一检查失败立即停并报告。
A.value_en: Execute 13 steps of checks, build, report, P=E, dual release, and real install verification; stop and report on any failure.

P.value_zh: ME 执行本地检查/build/report；ADMIN 触发 redeploy_rules、tag、push；GitHub Actions 发布；ME 验证 PyPI。
P.value_en: ME performs local checks/build/report; ADMIN triggers redeploy_rules, tag, push; GitHub Actions publishes; ME verifies PyPI.
P.notes_zh: 不从角色文本推导实际权限。
P.notes_en: Actual authority is not inferred from role text.

R.value_zh: P0/irreversible；13 步；PyPI 同版本不可覆盖，失败仅 yank 并升 1.6.1；任一检查失败暂停。
R.value_en: P0/irreversible; 13 steps; same PyPI version cannot be overwritten, failure only yank then 1.6.1; pause on any check failure.

V.value_en: release process, Rules 7/8/9.5.1/0.a.1/0.c, ADR-0024, ADR-0006, and release.yml.

C.value_en: A/B/C/D green, build/smoke, P=E, Actions green, both PyPI packages visible/installable, command works, REPORT/archive.

B.value_zh: 不得由 ME 自主 tag/push/publish；检查失败立即停；不得掩盖 snapshot 漂移；不得将 11 件 untracked 噪音混入发布。
B.value_en: ME must not self-tag/push/publish; stop immediately on check failure; do not hide snapshot drift; do not mix 11 untracked noises into release.
B.notes_zh: 不可逆动作必须单独触发。
